epic.summary: FX_SPOT Trading and FIX Integration with ET

business_context: Introduce FIX-router execution for FOREX FX_SPOT against Electronic Trading (ET): ET general FIX spec, message examples, additional fields on fill, tag mapping, and routing all FX_SPOT orders to ET per linked Confluence requirements.

synthesis.problem_gist: Epic delivers a new FIX-router path so Corner routes FOREX FX_SPOT orders to ET Trader per ET FIX specs and message tables; extends orders with ET-specific fields (tolerance, price, quoteId, settlDate, value date) and persists ET execution tags (e.g. transaction id) in dxCore.

impact_areas.text: FIX session management (logon, proxy user BE) and order/tag mapping DX to ET
FX_SPOT order routing and execution venue configuration
dxCore execution extensions and downstream reporting identifiers

corner_trader.note: Default both clients per qa-project.json unless Jira excludes Adaptive; confirm at test time.

requirements.snippet_text: : Used FIX Messages description with examples : ET team manually prepared following FIX messages description for DX with examples. It includes only FIX messages that can be used for DX↔ ET FIX integration for: Pricing (Done on DxFeed side) FX Spot trading FX Forward Trading FX Spot Trading Additionally to standard order fields existing in DxCore model we should send to ET 2 following custom fields: Tolerance - min default tolerance according to - Only for MARKET order Price - current instrument price according to the quantity on the moment of order creation ( ) - Only for MARKET order QuoteId - unique identifier of each ask/bid price taken according to the quantity on the moment of order creation ( ) - Only for MARKET order SettlDate - the date of quotes publishing taken according to the quantity on the moment of order creation ( ) - Only for MARKET order (New Order Extension should be introduced for these fields) Value Date - see Used FIX Messages For FX Spot trading only Following FIX messages should be used: Messages sent from DX to ET: NewOrderMultileg (35=AB) Placing MARKET order NewOrderSingle (35=D) - placing LIMIT or STOP order OrderCancelReplaceRequest (35=G) - modifying LIMIT and STOP order OrderCancelRequest (35=F) - canceling LIMIT and STOP order Messages sent from ET to DX: ExecutionReport (35=8) Partial fills support: Partial fills are not expected . ET can fill order only fully or reject it. So support of Partial fills in FIX integration should NOT be implemented and tested Key tags to be sent from Dx to ET in ALL FIX messages including administrative FIX Tag Value 8 - FIX Version
requirements.jira_context: Linked from CRT-617 Epic description (ET FIX integration scope).
